article_title: AI 写发票模板：模型打平，评分器留下
core_theme: 两个模型生成的发票模板在九项评分中完全打平；真正值得保留的是能重复检查 HTML 与 PDF 的评分器。
reader_takeaway: 模型分数接近时，不要继续猜谁更强；把发票的打印规则和分页结果写成可重复执行的检查。
summary_angle: 两张几乎相同的发票接受同一把九格评分尺，结果都是 9/9；唯一还能看出的差异，是打印后表头背景色是否保住。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文对比了 Claude Fable 5.1 与 GPT-6 Astra 各 5 份模板，10 份全部 9/9。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 左右两张几乎相同的发票被同一把平衡尺压住，两侧同时落下相同的通过印记。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文评分器包含 5 项 HTML 检查和 4 项 PDF 渲染检查。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 中央是一把带九个清晰刻槽的黄铜评分尺，逐格对齐两张发票的页眉、明细行与合计区。

information_blocks.source_anchor: 原文唯一真实差异是 print-color-adjust: exact：Claude 5/5，Astra 0/5。
information_blocks.visual_idea: 其中一张纸的灰色表头带保持饱满，另一张在侧光下明显褪色；差异只落在这条窄色带上。

main_metaphor: 两张外观相同的发票放在校准台上，被同一把九格黄铜评分尺测量；尺子留下结果，表头色带留下唯一差异。
primary_subject: 一把横跨画面的黄铜九格评分尺，下方压着两张发票纸。
subject_action: 评分尺将两张发票对齐、压平并同时盖上相同的通过印记，只把褪色的表头色带单独框出。
composition: 左右双页对称，中央评分尺形成单点焦点，背景留出纸张与彩色铅笔的横向空间。
selected_style_prompt_descriptor: colored-pencil picture-book illustration, tactile strokes, gentle palette, warm narrative objects, soft educational tone
selected_style_reason: 用户要求重做封面；使用 pick-cover-style.py 从风格池随机选中彩铅绘本风，纸张、校准尺与手工检查的氛围适合这种质感。
style_safety_note: 风格为泛类型描述，不涉及品牌、工作室或在世艺术家复刻；prompt 只使用笔触、纸张与光线描述。
draft_goal: 第一轮先验证两张发票与中央九格评分尺能否一眼读出「打平」，同时让褪色表头成为清楚的次级差异。
revision_targets: 让九格评分尺与发票的关系更直接，减少背景物件
确保「打平」「评分器」「背景色」三个标签清晰且不拥挤
如果画面被读成普通办公场景，加强评分尺的对齐与盖章动作
final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a new wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration summarizing an article about comparing two AI-generated invoice templates. Both models wrote five templates, all ten scored 9/9, so the comparison ended in a tie. The lasting value is a repeatable nine-check scorer for HTML and rendered PDFs. The one visible difference is whether the table-header background survives printing. The reader should quickly understand: the models tied, the scorer is the real result, and the remaining difference is background color.

Summary angle: two nearly identical invoice sheets are held under one brass nine-notch scoring ruler and both receive the same approval stamp; only a narrow gray table-header band on one sheet is visibly faded. Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a wide 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and three supporting narrative beats, each mapped to the article.
Information blocks:
- contrast: two symmetrical invoice sheets look almost identical and are balanced under the same ruler, both marked with the short Chinese label 打平 and the number 9/9
- mechanism: a horizontal brass scoring ruler with nine clear notches aligns the header, line-item rows, and total block on both sheets like a workshop calibration tool; the short Chinese label 评分器 appears once
- evidence: one narrow gray table-header band stays rich while the matching band on the other invoice is visibly washed out under side light; the short Chinese label 背景色 points only to this band

Main metaphor: two nearly identical invoices placed on a calibration desk, measured by the same nine-notch brass ruler; the ruler records the tie while the header band reveals the only difference.
Subject: one broad aged-brass nine-notch scoring ruler spanning the center, pressing two invoice sheets flat; both sheets carry an identical approval stamp, while a small magnified inset isolates the faded versus preserved header bands.
Composition/framing: left-right symmetry of the two invoice sheets, with the scoring ruler as the single strong focal point across the center; generous horizontal breathing room; no people.
Style/medium: combine conceptual editorial illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: colored-pencil picture-book illustration, tactile strokes, gentle palette, warm narrative objects, soft educational tone. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: warm ivory paper, graphite gray, muted vermilion accents, sage green stamp ink; low-saturation and paper-forward.
Environment: a clean wooden calibration desk with sparse colored pencils and one paper grid at the far edges; no office clutter.
Visible text policy: allow only the three short Chinese labels 打平, 评分器, 背景色, and the number 9/9. No poster title, no model names, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter, no people, no logos.
Avoid: portrait, model brand logos, chat UI screenshots, dashboards, fake code windows, floating microchips, code rain, neon purple-blue light, unrelated icon collage, poster title.
